guest.label: the platform's own logo — drop it at brands/<brand>/guests/<slug>.svg (or .png) and pass --guest <slug>

eyebrow.label: the small mono line, e.g. NOW TRACKED or INDEXED

name.label: the platform's name, as THEY write it — 12: the mark took the right column at 440px, so the copy holds 128..960 and 12 characters at 100px is the ceiling (DefiLlama 9, CoinGecko 10, Messari 7)

index.label: the readout row — what the platform tracks and where we sit, e.g. DEX TVL · BASE. Facts only, no numbers the milestone ladder hasn't earned Maximum 24: the index stays in the left column before the guest mark.

about.label: one short line on what the listing means for us — plain words. Never a value claim, never a number. Optional: a listing without it renders without the line

reference.label: the platform's own page for us, e.g. defillama.com/protocol/umbrae — the readout a reader copies to verify the listing, the scam guard applied to the index. VERIFY IT BEFORE IT SHIPS. Optional: a listing without a verified URL renders without the line, never with a placeholder Maximum 48: measured against both shipped brand fonts at the 34px reference floor. Use a shorter verified page URL or omit this optional field; never truncate a URL into a different address.

support.label: one line on what is now possible — never a claim on their behalf
